methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.

actual_scope: Reduce overhead in the complete PR3806 chirp-residue replay, preserving every literal state predicate and every other source check.
scope_change_reason: The replay-runtime card is specialized to one unchanged source-bound complete command.
bottleneck_link: Coverage-preserving faster scientific replay reduces verification friction. It does not lower a supplier invoice or the multiplication exponent.
stop_rule: Stop after the first verified complete-command improvement and package it.
evidence: Scoped written equivalence proof; complete ordered-rollout equality, initial-state and source-drift rejection controls; five alternating fresh-process timing pairs.
